Name: Ness from Earthbound replacing Vincent
Author: Synthwave Knight
TagLine: If you ever wanted to see the chosen hero who also happens to be Sans in Stardew Valley, look no further.
Description:
Changes Vincent into Ness, the main character from Earthbound/Mother 2. Other than the sprites the name is also changed everywhere so you won't see Vincent still in dialogues, in the menu and similar. Certain lines were also changed (for example Vincent hunting for bugs is now Ness hunting for hamburgers in trash cans). 

Requirements:
- SMAPI
- Content Patcher

To install manually simply drop the [CP] Ness folder into your Stardew Valley mods folder, after getting the required things. To remove the mod, remove the Ness folder from your Stardew Valley mods folder.﻿

Although it's my own (best attempt at making a) sprite, Ness and Earthbound still belong to Nintendo, HAL Laboratory and Shigesato Itoi. I am in no way earning money from this nor am trying to label Ness as my own original character.
